name: Nature
languages: all those of the creature who summoned it

traits.name: The Law of Nature
traits.text:
Allies within 20 feet have
advantage on all saving throws.

traits.name: Inexorable
traits.text:
The Inexorables are immune to any
effects that would slow them or deny them
actions or movement.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text: Nature’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 17). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: * 3/day: banishment, counterspell

traits.name: By Will Alone
traits.text:
As a reaction to missing an attack,
Nature makes a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On
a successful save, the original attack is successful.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
Nature makes two slam attacks or
makes one slam attack and casts banishment.

actions.name: Slam
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft.,
one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage
plus 18 (4d8) force damage.
